newsitem.title: FINLAND: CYCLICAL OUTLOOK FOR FINNISH SMES POSITIVE -KTM.
newsitem.headline: CYCLICAL OUTLOOK FOR FINNISH SMES POSITIVE -KTM.

text.p: The cyclical outlook for Finnish small- and medium-sized enterprises is positive, the ministry of trade and industry said in a statement on Tuesday.
Following are key branch-by-branch prospects from the ministry's SME report:
* Electric and electronics industry -- Near-term outlook increasingly better vs past six months. Expectations for growth in output and personnel strong, but investments seen moderate.
Exports develpment clearly positive, exports to EU-countries seen growing most rapidly.

* Metal products industry --- Sees output, investments and jobs increasing in the near-term. Profitability and solvency ratios seen developing favourably. Most see exports growing, with metal structure makers the only exception.

* Machine, equipment and vehicles manufacturers -- Outlook has improved steadily since last spring, particularly for the vehicles' industry. Orderbooks and output seen picking-up. Exports mainly to neighbouring countries.
* Mechanical forest industry -- Outlook positive, orderbooks seen growing. Output and personnel seen increasing, but investments likely to remain modest. More firms now exporters.
* Plastic products manufacturers - Near-term expectations positive. Most see output and orders growing, particularly in the packaging and in the building plastics industries.
Only about one-fifth of the plastics products companies are exporters.
* Concrete industry -- Near-term outlook seen improving slightly. Orderbooks, output and personnel are seen turning to growth in the next six months.
* Food industry -- Firm outlook for the whole sector with output, orders, personnel and investments seen growing. The focus is mainly on the domestic market.
* Furniture manufacturers -- Outlook improving with output and orderbooks seen growing. Exports seen picking-up in the next six months.
